Sobre a vaga

The Role

We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who can design, build, and ship across the stack. You’ll help architect new systems, stabilize existing ones, and establish best practices that let us move quickly without breaking trust with users. You won’t just be writing code — you’ll be actively shaping the way we build, deploy, and maintain software.

We’re not just looking for someone to check tickets — we want someone who enjoys spinning up new features from scratch, simplifying complexity, and bringing order to fast-moving product cycles. You’ll be expected to lean heavily on AI tools (Claude Code, Devin, etc.) to accelerate development, reduce repetitive work, and prototype solutions faster than a traditional team could.

This is a role with a high degree of ownership and visibility: you’ll work directly with leadership, influence technical decisions from day one, and see your work hit production on a weekly cadence.

Our Engineering Culture

  • Quality first: We focus on building stable, reliable systems — speed matters, but not at the cost of trust.
  • Bias to action: We move quickly and prefer small, shippable increments over big-bang releases.
  • AI as a teammate: Engineers experiment with AI tools daily — to code, test, and even generate docs — and share what works.
  • Simplicity over cleverness: We aim for solutions that are easy to understand, extend, and debug.
  • Collaboration: Engineers work hand-in-hand with product and customer success; no silos.
  • Transparency: We value clear communication — prioritize, execute, communicate, repeat.

What You’ll Do

  • Build full-stack features in React, Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL.
  • Help unify multiple apps into one consistent architecture.
  • Set up and refine CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
  • Use AI tools for coding, testing, and prototyping as part of daily workflow.
  • Collaborate closely with product, customer success, and leadership to prioritize and ship features.
  • Maintain a balance of speed and stability.

What We’re Looking For

  • Solid experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js/Express.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, AWS (Beanstalk/ECS), Auth0, GitHub Actions.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous, early-stage environments.
  • Curiosity and excitement about leveraging AI to build software faster and smarter.
  • Pragmatic, team-oriented mindset: willing to dive in wherever needed.

Who You Are

You love building fast, keeping things simple, and experimenting with new tools — especially AI — to give yourself and your team an edge. You thrive in small, high-ownership environments and enjoy being part of a team that values execution, clarity, and iteration over endless planning.

Why Join Us

  • Impact from day one: small team, meaningful ownership.
  • Help define the future of AI-assisted engineering.
  • Early-stage pace with weekly or bi-weekly releases — fast iteration, visible progress.
  • Chance to build foundational systems that will scale with the company.
  • Flexible location - negotiable

Vensure Employer Solutions is a privately owned professional employer organization (PEO) headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, with offices in Sarasota, Florida, and Duluth, Georgia. As the nation’s fastest-growing PEO, Vensure uses industry-leading technology to offer complete, end-to-end solutions for payroll, human resources, benefits, risk management, and workers’ compensation services. From payroll processing and tax preparation, to full-suite benefits administration and claims management, VensureHR has payroll, HR, benefits, risk management, and workers’ compensation specialists to assist business owners with their unique business needs. Whether a product demo or specialized customer support, our service specialists provide the tools, resources, and industry expertise to help clients succeed. Vensure is committed to helping thousands of clients manage, nurture, and grow their businesses by providing employee and employer-related administration services. To learn more, visit https://vensure.com/.
